version.changelog: v5.1.2 — refreshes ClawHub summary metadata; installed skill remains focused on outbound mail and existing-address inbound context, with managed receiving waitlist/private beta.

llm.summary: This is a coherent mailbox.bot integration for sending and handling physical mail, but users should treat it as access to real mail and sensitive documents.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose matches the artifacts: a remote postal-mail API/MCP skill for outbound mail, forwarded inbound document context, postal threads, and private-beta managed receiving actions.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The skill discloses automatic MAILBOX.md rules, approval flags, sandbox mode, cost caps, and force-approval options, but destructive mail actions such as shred, dispose, return, and discard should be manually approval-gated by users.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Installation is documented as a remote MCP server using bearer authentication; there are no executable artifact files, with an optional npx mcp-remote bridge only for clients that require a local command.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Remote transmission of documents, mail metadata, API credentials, and inbound context is inherent to the service and is disclosed by the remote endpoint and tool descriptions; no broad local filesystem indexing or hidden local execution was found.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The service can use scoped agent keys, sandbox keys, webhooks, remote notes/tags, and managed-mailbox actions; users should prefer agent-scoped test keys and avoid broad member keys unless necessary.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you intend to let mailbox.bot handle real postal workflows. Use sandbox or agent-scoped keys first, set force approval for live keys, require approval for legal/government/financial mail and for shred/dispose/return/discard actions, and avoid sending sensitive documents unless the account, retention, and privacy terms meet your needs.
llm.findings:
[suspicious.exposed_secret_literal] expected: The static scan matched placeholder examples such as sk_live_xxxxxxxxxxxxx and sk_agent_..., not an actual exposed credential in the artifacts.
[SQP-2] expected: The advisory destructive-action concerns map to disclosed, purpose-aligned mailbox capabilities; the risk is operational rather than hidden or deceptive, so it is best handled with explicit user approval for destructive or ambiguous mail handling.
[SQP-2] expected: The advisory remote-MCP privacy concern is valid user guidance: the install connects to mailbox.bot and uses bearer auth, but this is central to the advertised remote postal-mail workflow rather than an unexpected data path.
